unloadRadius.description: Chebyshev distance from which a chunk is released; must be greater than loadRadius.

chunksPerStep.description: Maximum chunks generated per simulation step.

originShiftThreshold.description: Hero distance from the render origin, per axis, that triggers an origin shift (SDD 03 §1).

maxPropsPerChunk.description: Fixed capacity of the prop list in each ChunkData (SDD 03 §2.1 allows up to 26).

hordeRenderSlack.description: Extra instance capacity per enemy type on top of the simultaneous-enemy cap (rounds.json maxSimultaneous), also the death-ghost capacity.

propAvoidLookahead.description: Distance ahead, in units, at which enemies start steering around a blocking prop (SDD 03 section 4).

cullDistance.description: Enemies farther than this from the hero are removed without a drop (SDD 03).

propSteerGain.description: How hard a prop dead ahead bends an enemy's heading (1 = fully sideways at contact).

propSteerMargin.description: Extra clearance, in units, kept when deciding that a prop is in an enemy's way.
